title: Deficiency Balance Accounts Lump-Sum Settlement Amount Computation Sheet
content:
**Computation.** A lump-sum settlement offer on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts states the band's lowest lump-sum settlement percent of the balance on the offer date, rounded half up to the cent, raised to the band's settlement floor where it is lower, and never more than the balance.

**Order of the figures.** The percentage points of the surcharge schedules that apply are added to the band's lowest lump-sum settlement percent before that percent is applied once to the balance; the product is rounded half up to the cent; any reduction amount a schedule sets, itself rounded half up to the cent, is then subtracted from that rounded figure; and only after that is the figure raised to the settlement floor where lower and limited to the balance.

## Band figures used

| Band | Lowest lump-sum settlement percent | Settlement floor |
|---|---|---|
| Band 1 | 60.0% | $250.00 |
| Band 2 | 55.0% | $500.00 |
| Band 3 | 50.0% | $750.00 |
| Band 4 | 45.0% | $1000.00 |
| Band 5 | 40.0% | $1500.00 |
| Band 6 | 35.0% | $2000.00 |

## Computation lines

1. Percent: the band's lowest lump-sum settlement percent, plus the points added.
2. Balance on the offer date multiplied by the percent, divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent.
3. Less any reduction amount, rounded half up to the cent.
4. Raised to the settlement floor where lower; then limited to the balance.

## Worked figures (hypothetical balances, no points added and no reduction)

| Band | Balance | Percent figure | After the floor | Offer amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Band 4 | $10,000.00 | $4,500.00 | $4,500.00 | $4,500.00 |
| Band 1 | $300.00 | $180.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 |
| Band 2 | $400.00 | $220.00 | $500.00 | $400.00 (limited to the balance) |

A hypothetical illustration of the order: Band 4, balance $10,000.00, 4.0 points added and a reduction of $500.00. The percent is 49.0%, the percent figure $4,900.00; the reduction leaves $4,400.00, which is above the $1000.00 floor and below the balance, so the offer states $4,400.00.
